title: One comparator step scans the next column
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word, let $p$ be a valid input-head position for $x$, and let $w_0,w_1,w_2,w_3$ be finite Boolean words. For any $j\in\mathbb{N}$ strictly less than the maximum of their lengths, one step of the four-tape comparator from the configuration whose control is the state after $j$ columns and whose four tape heads are at position $j$ gives the configuration with control after $j+1$ columns and all four tape heads at position $j+1$, leaving the input-head position and tape contents unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ is strictly less than the maximum length of the four words.
replaced: For every input word, input position, four words, and position $j$ strictly below the common width, one comparator step from the scanning control after $j$ columns yields exactly the next column: the control is the orbit value after $j+1$ columns and all four heads have moved right.
